q1_issues.issue: The entire quoted proposition is unrepresented: sk_say_1 has no Theme, so the sealed complement, the negated seeing event, the "so" connective atom, and the negated future granting are all absent - the parse records only that West said something.
(Member sk_urgency_1 urgency) is stranded: it is the definite-projection of a complement that was never emitted, so the parse asserts that an urgency exists while dropping the denial that scopes it.
(Member sk_thing_1 thing) is likewise a stranded witness with no predication attached, and one witness cannot cover both "this" and "it", which are separate referents in the quote.

q2_gaps: direct (verbatim quoted) speech as the complement of a speech verb - the Propositional attitudes section licenses only a finite that-clause complement, and says nothing about how quotation marks are treated or whether the quoted clause seals under Theme
first-person deixis inside a quotation ("I", "I'm") resolving to the speaker of the reporting clause - Coreference & anaphora covers only he/she/it/they
a sentence-final reporting clause ("...," West said) rather than the matrix-first "X said that P" order
notes: The say frame itself is right (event + Experiencer holder + Past per the attitude section), but it carries no content, so essentially the whole sentence is missing. Same species of loss as tierD-000160's unattached "Jones said".
